summary: This week in AI, significant advancements were made in LLMs, with models like Claude and Gemini achieving milestones. NVIDIA announced new partnerships and investments in AI infrastructure, while OpenAI expanded its Daybreak cybersecurity program.
insight: The increasing adoption of AI in various industries is driving innovation, with companies like Meta and NVIDIA investing heavily in AI research and development, and startups like River AI securing large funding rounds.
highlights: Gemini becomes Google's fastest-growing product ever, hitting 1 billion users
NVIDIA announces partnerships with major investors to establish independent financing platforms for AI infrastructure
OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux and expands its Daybreak cybersecurity program
